LESSON: POLYGAMY IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.4: Polygamy in Islam
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Polygamy in Islam, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What is the rationale for polygamy in Islam?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
